paragraphs: Our standard B2B DPA incorporates concrete engineering safeguards:
bullets: Binding confidentiality obligations (NDA) across all assigned engineering personnel.
Least-privilege access controls, isolated environment credentials, and prompt access revocation upon project completion.
Secure coding practices aligned with OWASP ASVS and TLS encryption in transit.
Prompt security incident notification assistance if an event impacts Sundawa-managed scope.

sections.heading: Sub-Processors & Data Return / Deletion
paragraphs: Sundawa does not engage additional sub-processors on client production data without prior written client authorization.
Upon contract termination, any client datasets or temporary credentials held under Sundawa’s control are securely returned or permanently deleted per written client instruction.

sections.heading: Requesting Our Standard B2B DPA
paragraphs: To request a review copy of PT Sundawa Teknologi Indonesia’s standard B2B Data Processing Agreement for procurement or legal review, email contact@sundawa.net with subject "[Legal / DPA Request]".
